d:
Enjoy the timeless charm of “Kaamdev Jaisi Teri Suratiya” from the 1970 Bollywood film Tum Haseen Main Jawan, featuring the evergreen on-screen pair Dharmendra and Hema Malini. The melodious voice of Suman Kalyanpur brings a special sweetness to this classic Hindi film song.
Kaamdev Jaisi Teri Suratiya | Tum Haseen Main Jawan 1970 | Dharmendra, Hema Malini | Suman Kalyanpur
Song: Kaamdev Jaisi Teri Suratiya
Movie: Tum Haseen Main Jawan (1970)
Star Cast: Dharmendra, Hema Malini
Singer: Suman Kalyanpur
Music Director: Shankar Jaikishan
Lyricist: Indeevar
